description.value: You know how to bypass your limits in subtle ways with your cards. You @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.9Tbqe5G8pdrrOUfT]{Draw Card} and then choose one card in your hand. The card chosen is tucked away in a tiny extraplanar seam of your making, trapping the future it portrays in a space removed from the universe. You can only store 1 card at a time. While in this space, you cannot use the card for Cardplay actions, but you can sift the card back into your hand as a single concentrate action. If the card remains in the space for more than 1 minute, the card is discarded as the seam you made fixes itself.
